A '''monobubble bongo''' was a type of [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]], or bongo, used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. It featured a single [[Hydrostatic field/Legends|hydrostatic field]] canopy to protect its [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. The monobubble bongo could be modified to be used in [[bongo racing|bongo races]].
